honest_finding: Mean-pooling both eyes' frozen features and using the ordinal head beats grading each eye separately then taking the worse one, and this holds across all 3 tested feature configs: tf_efficientnet_b0@224 diff=+0.075 CI [0.045, 0.105]; tf_efficientnet_b0@384 diff=+0.072 CI [0.046, 0.098]; resnet50@224 diff=+0.063 CI [0.029, 0.097]. This is a robust, backbone-independent effect, not an artifact of one feature space.
